limits: Reads the stored document; it does not check it.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Reads a stored document unchanged; it computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does a named project document hold, as a record?

description: Read a CHOSEN project document as a record — the pipeline's data-reader source, for running on a specific file instead of whatever happens to be open in the editor. Wire its `record` into any downstream node's $subject.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

document.description: the project document to read — its id, or its exact name (`list_library` lists them).

name: load_record

record.description: the chosen document as a record (subject for downstream nodes)
